messages:
kevin: Heads up — Q3 capacity forecast shows embed+rerank GPU hours could hit ~2.6x baseline if we keep a single pool. Need proposals to avoid OOMs and cost spikes.
maria: Can you post the breakdown (batch vs realtime) + model families? quick numbers pls.
kevin: Quick sim extract: daily GPU hrs baseline 420 -> peak ~1090. Realtime accounts for ~65% token volume, batch ~35%. APAC demand concentrated 14:00-20:00 UTC. Models are rwd-embed-v2 + open-rerank-1.
aj: Clarify latency tolerance — realtime SLO is p95 <= 120ms, batch can be <= 30s. If true, separate pools make sense.
lucy: +1 on separate pools. Proposal: persistent low-latency pool sized for 95th realtime QPS; a preemptible burst pool for batch and overflow. Also prefer co-located KV cache for realtime.
sam: Cost quick calc: at ~$2.5/hr per GPU extra ~670 GPU-hrs/day -> ~$1.7k/day -> ~~$50k/month. Need to show tradeoffs vs single overprovisioning.
kevin: Simulation notes (very rough): avg request tokens 512, peak realtime qps 3k, KV hit 20% => effective token load drops. Using tokens_per_gpu_per_hour ~1.2e8 (A100-40 equiv) we get the estimate above.
aj: Pasted sim snippet:
```
# sim summary
peak_qps_realtime=3000
avg_seq_len=512
kv_hit=0.2
gpu_efficiency=0.85
# tokens_per_gpu_per_hour is an input from perf bench
est_gpu_hrs_peak = (peak_qps_realtime * avg_seq_len * (1-kv_hit)) / tokens_per_gpu_per_hour
```
kevin: tokens_per_gpu_per_hour used was 1.2e8 on our stack (with our inference kernels + batching).
maria: Region constraints: APAC cannot spill to US due to latency + customer data posture; EU can spill to US for non-regulated traffic for now. Also note bandwidth/egress costs if we cross regions.
lucy: Ops plan draft:
- autoscaler policy: min_persistent for realtime per-region (APAC/EU/US)
- burst preemptible pool in US+EU for batch jobs; APAC burst only if latency is acceptable
- queue-length-based shedding to chunk non-critical reranks into batch window
Config snippet:
```yaml
pools:
  realtime_persistent:
    region: apac
    min_gpus: 20
    max_gpus: 80
    preemptible: false
  burst_batch:
    region: us,eu
    min_gpus: 0
    max_gpus: 200
    preemptible: true
```
ops-bot: [deploy] autoscaler-config v2 applied to staging at 1850005000 by lucy
aj: Runbook checklist: 1) size persistent pool = ceil(95th_qps / (tokens_per_gpu_per_sec * avg_seq_len_effective)) 2) provision burst pool with preemptible instances 3) add cost alert at $40k/month forecast 4) test spillover behavior in staging
sam: I'll own the cost alert + a short exec deck showing savings vs single-pool overprovisioning and the payback window.
kevin: Timeline: staging tests by Friday (1850006000), prod rollout next Tue. Who's on-call that week for handover?
maria: I'm on-call that week, will handle handover. pinging kevin for runbook bits.
kevin: Thanks. Small perf tweak: enable prefix KV caching for longer rerank sessions — should shave ~10-15% token load on realtime pool.
infra-bot: Alert (info): current embed_pool_utilization=0.87, expected ramp in ~6h based on historical diurnal.
lucy: We'll spin a short APAC-only sim run with the new autoscaler rules and get updated GPU-hr delta. Please add any regional constraints or model overrides we should consider.
kevin: Also consider a mixed strategy: keep a small overprovision for edge spikes + aggressive batch burst. That buys SLO headroom and reduces total preemptible churn.
maria: noted. adding compliance note for EU regulated customers (no cross-border rerank).
kevin: Good. Sam/aj/lucy — can you each add one slide to the deck by EOD tomorrow with your section?
